Usage: assay <command> [arguments] [options]

  overview  <solution>                              Show solution overview

  project   assemblies   <solution> <project>       List assembly references
  project   diagnostics  <solution> <project>       Show project diagnostics
  type      detail       <solution> <type>          Show type detail
  type      rels         <solution> <type>          Show type relationships
  type      hierarchy    <solution> <type>          Show type inheritance hierarchy
  type      context      <solution> <type>          Get full context bundle for a type
  type      usages       <solution> <type>          Show where a type is used
  type      decompile    <solution> <type>          Decompile an external/NuGet type to C# source
  member    <solution> <member>                     Show member detail with callers and callees
  impact    <solution> <subject>                    Analyze impact of changing an entity (type or member)
  assembly  <solution> <assembly>                   Show assembly detail
  namespace <solution> <namespace>                  Show namespace summary
  path      <solution> <from> <to>                  Find dependency path between entities
  churn     <solution>                              Show churn hotspots

  licenses  <solution>                              Show package license report
  tests     gaps         <solution>                 Find

result.stdout:
Usage: assay namespace [solution] <namespace> [options]

Show namespace summary

Arguments:
  solution   Path to a .sln/.slnx file (auto-detected if omitted)
  namespace  Namespace to summarize

Options:
  --nested           Include nested namespaces
  --max N            Maximum types shown (default: 50)
  --coverage <path>  Use an existing coverage report (file or glob), or 'auto' to collect
  --no-coverage      Skip coverage entirely: no collection, no report discovery (output shows n/a)
  --json             Output as JSON instead of structured markdown
  --lightweight      Use structural-only analysis (fast, no Roslyn)
  --no-cache         Force re-analysis, bypassing the graph cache
  --verbose          Show progress and diagnostic output on stderr
  -h, --help         Show this help and exit

Arguments:

Options:
  --threshold N        CRAP score threshold (default: 30)
  --top N              Top N results (default: 20)

  --sort <K>           Sort key: crap, volatility, combined (default: combined)
  --scope <project>    Scope to a project
  --coverage <path>    Use an existing coverage report (file or glob), or 'auto' to collect

  --verbose            Show progress and diagnostic output on stderr

result.stdout:
Usage: assay kitchensink [solution] [options]

Run all analyses and prioritize findings (alias: all, triage)

Arguments:
  solution  Path to a .sln/.slnx file (auto-detected if omitted)

Options:
  --top N                Top N findings per category (default: 5)
  --severity S           Minimum severity to include (critical, high, medium, low) (default: low)
  --skip C               Skip a category (repeatable): vulnerability, license, crap, coveragegap, diagnostic, churn
  --fail-on S            Exit with code 2 if any finding is at or above this severity
  --output <dir>         Write a markdown+HTML report bundle to a directory
  --exclude-path <glob>  Exclude paths matching a glob (repeatable)
  --include-generated    Include code-generated members (excluded by default)
  --coverage <path>      Use an existing coverage report (file or glob), or 'auto' to collect
  --no-coverage          Skip coverage entirely: no collection, no report discovery (output shows n/a)
  --json                 Output as JSON instead of structured markdown
  --lightweight          Use structural-only analysis (fast, no Roslyn)
  --no-cache             Force re-analysis, bypassing the graph cache
  --verbose              Show progress and diagnostic output on stderr
  -h, --help             Show this help and exit
